audit_method: git fetch origin; read docs/REPOSITORY_SCOPE.md and docs/CANONICAL_CAMPAIGN_RUNNER.md and src/apertus_cscs_campaign/cli.py at current origin/main (not from the experiment tree)
missing_canonical_role: post-hoc read-only evaluation of released checkpoints outside any campaign
why_none_fit: Every evaluation verb is campaign-bound. run-evaluation-in-allocation and probe --role evaluation both require --manifest (a compiled apertus_campaign_v3 manifest), --run-root (a campaign run root) and a declared evaluator milestone --iteration. This experiment has no campaign: it scores three already-frozen, released checkpoints of a completed trajectory. No additive flag on an existing verb expresses 'no manifest, no run root, no milestone'.

experiment_owned_instead.justification: These are scientific evaluation transformations, which docs/REPOSITORY_SCOPE.md explicitly leaves with the owning experiment ('evaluation-set selection and winner criteria'). None carries a submit_/supervise_/finalize_/watch_/freeze_ prefix and none performs a holder, permit, adoption, or receipt-state-machine role.

note: The experiment checkout used for this audit was 12 commits behind origin/main; the audit was re-run against origin/main and the conclusion is unchanged (readiness.py reuse blocker identical; no new evaluation or diagnostic verb).
